appearance.value: grey-green, swordlike, tapered tip, hairy tuft at the base

architecture.value: hollow stems, unbranched or with small bamboo-like side shoots
architecture.quote: either unbranched or with small bamboo-like side shoots

architecture.value: tall perennial reed or cane; resembles an outsize common reed or bamboo; forms dense stands
architecture.quote: Overall, the plant resembles an outsize common reed

architecture.value: tough fibrous underground rhizomes forming knotty spreading mats
architecture.quote: tough, fibrous underground rhizomes that form knotty, spreading mats

propagation.fact: mostly reproduces vegetatively by rhizomes; stem and rhizome pieces with a single node can sprout
propagation.quote: mostly reproduces vegetatively by tough, fibrous underground rhizomes

propagation.fact: pieces under 5 cm with a single node sprout readily; floods spread pieces downstream
propagation.quote: containing a single node could sprout readily under a variety of conditions

propagation.fact: usually seedless or with rarely fertile seeds
propagation.quote: usually seedless or with seeds that are rarely fertile

life_form.quote: is a tall perennial reed or cane species

description.value: Tall perennial reed or cane, generally 6 m, with hollow stems, grey-green swordlike leaves and upright white feathery plumes.
description.quote: Arundo donax generally grows to 6 metres (20 ft) in height

native_range.value: Eastern Mediterranean region and across southern Asia to Japan
native_range.quote: is native to the eastern Mediterranean region and across southern Asia to Japan

introduced_range.value: Widely planted and naturalised in mild temperate, subtropical and tropical regions; invasive in North America and Oceania.
introduced_range.quote: has been widely planted and naturalised in the mild temperate, subtropical and tropical regions of both hemispheres

environment.value: Damp soils, fresh or moderately saline; dense stands on disturbed sites, dunes, wetlands and riparian habitats.
environment.quote: grows in damp soils, either fresh or moderately saline
